boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named John Brown University places with documented uses for studying, meeting, eating, creating, performing, or taking an outdoor break.

cards.title: Reset Between Classes in the Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Walker Student Center lounge for commuters
cards.notes: Bring lunch or coursework; use the study desks, group tables, charging station, lockers, microwave, and refrigerator responsibly.
cards.short_summary: A commuter-focused base for studying, eating, charging devices, and storing daily supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU says the lounge is in Walker Student Center and provides group tables, individual study desks, food-storage appliances, lockers, and device charging.
cards.source_title: Places and Spaces for Commuter Students at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Intended for commuter students; lockers are first-come, first-served, and users must supply a lock.

cards.title: Find a Table at the Center of Campus
cards.subtitle: Shared tables, student services, and nearby food options
cards.notes: Use a table for a study break or informal meetup, then check the building directory before visiting a student-service office.
cards.short_summary: A central indoor gathering point that combines tables, food options, and student-facing offices.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU identifies Walker Student Center as a central place to study or gather, with many tables, nearby food options, and the commuter lounge.
cards.source_title: Places and Spaces for Commuter Students at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Building access and individual office hours may vary; follow posted campus access rules.

cards.title: Meet Outside the Library for Group Work
cards.subtitle: Tables and couches beside the library and Media Lab
cards.notes: Choose the lobby when conversation is part of the assignment; its tables and couches suit group work between classes.
cards.short_summary: A practical collaboration area immediately outside the quieter library environment.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU describes the LRC Lobby as a quiet group-project and homework space outside the library, furnished with tables and couches near the Media Lab.
cards.source_title: Places and Spaces for Commuter Students at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Located directly outside the library; building access follows Learning Resource Center policies.

cards.title: Match the Study Setup to the Assignment
cards.subtitle: Desks, study centers, and rooms in the Learning Resource Center
cards.notes: Start at a desk for solo work or select a study room when the assignment requires discussion; ask library staff for help.
cards.short_summary: A flexible academic workspace offering several formats for individual and collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU says its library in the Learning Resource Center provides desks, study centers, and study rooms for student work.
cards.source_title: Places and Spaces for Commuter Students at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: JBU lists Monday–Wednesday 7:30 a.m.–2 a.m.; Thursday until midnight; Friday until 10 p.m.; Saturday 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sunday 2 p.m.–2 a.m.

cards.title: Take a Short Outdoor Pause by the Fountain
cards.subtitle: Campus landmark beside the Cathedral of the Ozarks
cards.notes: Pause here between indoor commitments, keep paths clear, and use the nearby campus setting for a brief reset or conversation.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor landmark suited to a short break near the Cathedral.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU explicitly recommends the Cathedral Fountain as an outdoor campus place where students can relax.
cards.source_title: Places and Spaces for Commuter Students at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is weather-dependent; observe campus signage and avoid obstructing surrounding walkways.

cards.title: Trade a Building Break for the Creek Trail
cards.subtitle: Outdoor route running through the JBU campus
cards.notes: Walk the campus portion during a daylight break, stay on the established route, and account for weather before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A campus trail option for movement and a change of setting between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU identifies the Sager Creek trail through campus as one of its recommended outdoor spaces.
cards.source_title: Places and Spaces for Commuter Students at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Use in suitable weather and follow posted trail or campus restrictions; the source does not state operating hours.

cards.title: Move Lunch or Reading onto the Covered Balcony
cards.subtitle: Second-floor outdoor tables at Walker Student Center
cards.notes: Bring lunch or a short reading task upstairs; use the covered tables while leaving room for others sharing the balcony.
cards.short_summary: A covered second-floor table area that adds fresh air without leaving the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU says the second-floor Walker Student Center Balcony is covered and furnished with multiple tables for eating outside.
cards.access_notes: Reach the balcony through Walker Student Center; availability depends on building access and weather conditions.

cards.title: Set Up a Picnic-Style Lunch on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Campus lawn with benches, trees, and a picnic table
cards.notes: Choose a bench, picnic table, or suitable lawn area on a fair-weather day, and pack out everything brought for lunch.
cards.short_summary: A flexible outdoor lunch setting with several kinds of seating across the central lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU recommends The Quad for picnic-style lunches and notes its lawn, shade trees, park benches, and picnic table.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use is weather-dependent; respect scheduled campus activities and posted grounds restrictions.

cards.title: Use the Gallery as a Visual Study Break
cards.subtitle: Rotating exhibitions in Windgate Visual Arts West
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition, visit during posted gallery hours, and slow down long enough to examine a few works closely.
cards.short_summary: A campus exhibition room that offers a focused change from conventional study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU says Windgate Art Gallery hosts exhibitions throughout the year and lists weekday and Sunday visiting hours.
cards.source_title: Visual Art Department | John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sunday 2–4 p.m.; confirm exhibit availability before visiting.

cards.title: Stay for the Post-Show Lobby Conversation
cards.subtitle: Gathering space outside Herklotz Auditorium
cards.notes: Arrive early enough to meet your group in the lobby, then remain after a production when cast members greet attendees.
cards.short_summary: A performance-night meeting point that supports conversation before and after campus productions.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU says the BPAC Lobby is used for gathering before and after productions and that cast members greet guests there after musicals and plays.
cards.source_title: Music & Theatre at John Brown University
cards.access_notes: Lobby access depends on scheduled events; performances may require tickets, so consult the university event listing.
